name: Orric, by Breakra
description: API-contract research for Aeon: watch OpenAPI specs, check PRs and releases for breaking changes with Breakra's deterministic engine (free, local, open source).
author: danbuildss

skills.description: Watch OpenAPI specs in public or your own GitHub repos; when a spec changes, Breakra classifies the change (BLOCK / REVIEW / SAFE) and Orric reports what matters.
Contract safety for your own repos: for open PRs that change an OpenAPI file, compare base vs head with Breakra and keep one PR comment with the verdict and evidence.
Flag a breaking change shipped as a patch or minor release: compares consecutive spec releases (tags or info.version) with Breakra.
